pr_title: Only check if play.hosts is a template when the play hasn't been finalized
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY Only check if play.hosts is a template when the play hasn't been finalized Fixes https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/73926 ##### ISSUE TYPE - Bugfix Pull Request ##### COMPONENT NAME ##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Reproducer

```yaml - name: one hosts: localhost gather_facts: false tasks: - add_host: name: "localhost{{ item }}" ansible_python_interpreter: '{{ ansible_playbook_python }}' groups: - new loop: "{{ range(2500) }}" - name: two hosts: "{{ groups.new }}" gather_facts: false connection: local tasks: - name: Execute extra tasks debug: ```

before: ``` real 2m30.090s user 2m13.497s sys 0m53.892s ``` after: ``` real 1m13.562s user 1m1.892s sys 0m52.183s ``` Extra context, the reason this becomes time consuming, with a lot of hosts, is that once finalized, the hosts field may become a list with thousands of individual hosts listed. We use `Environment.preprocess` in `ansible.template.is_template` which stringifies the field, and then has to iterate to the very end of the list to see if it is a template. So a template that results in a short output, isn't really affected. There are only 2 calls to `get_vars` before the play starts where `play.hosts` is actually a template, and then once finalized, it can no longer be a template.

issue_context.title: Massive overhead of hosts templating for every host of every task
issue_context.body:
### Summary

Executing a playbook with many hosts, there is massive overhead in checking whether the hosts list is a pattern, see for yourself on this callgrind graph:

![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3154871/111359016-4a4bf480-868b-11eb-8c8f-55b6a6a10bd7.png)

https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/da60525610a384bb04833b1c6429d9db6a87ef64/lib/ansible/vars/manager.py#L490

That check has quadratic runtime with the number of hosts - with a lot of hosts, commenting that check out reduces runtime manyfold.

### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

variable manager

### Ansible Version

2.10.5, devel

### OS / Environment

Ubuntu

### Steps to Reproduce

```yaml
- hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - set_fact:
        extra_tasks: true # compute it
        hosts: "{{ [an, array, with, 5100, computed, hosts] }}"

- hosts: "{{ hostvars.localhost.hosts }}"
  vars:
    extra_tasks: "{{ hostvars.localhost.do_extra_tasks }}"
  tasks:
   # some more tasks here
    - name: Execute extra tasks
      command: /bin/true # example
      when: extra_tasks
```

### Expected Results

Execute in tens of seconds.

### Actual Results

Take over 5 minutes to execute.
